dashboard.change.no_baseline: No traffic in the earlier period to compare against
dashboard.compare.label: Comparison
dashboard.drawer.title: {card} — {tab}
dashboard.filter.no_matches: Nothing matches in this period. Type a value and press Enter to filter by it anyway.
dashboard.goals.empty_hint: Set up a goal to measure the actions that matter — a signup, a purchase, a download.
dashboard.goals.none_converted: No goals converted in this period
dashboard.goals.none_converted_hint: Only goals with conversions are listed here. Every goal you have configured stays on the goals settings screen. Try a wider period, or clear a filter.
dashboard.behavior.explore.caveat: Explore follows what visitors did immediately before or after a page, event, or goal. Select a result to keep following the journey.
dashboard.behavior.explore.empty_hint: Pages, custom events, and configured goals appear here as traffic arrives.
dashboard.behavior.explore.no_steps: No adjacent activity in this period
dashboard.behavior.funnels.caveat: Funnels measure how many visitors progress through an ordered set of goals in one visit. Dashboard filters and the selected period apply.
dashboard.behavior.funnels.empty_hint: Combine two to eight goals to see where visitors leave an important flow.
dashboard.behavior.goals.caveat: Unique conversions count each visitor once. Total conversions count every matching event. CR is the share of visitors who converted.
dashboard.behavior.goals.automatic_ready: They will appear as visitors trigger downloads, outbound links, forms, or missing pages. Add the conversion that matters most to your business now.
dashboard.behavior.partial: Reporting starts {from}, when this configuration became measurable.
dashboard.behavior.properties.caveat: Custom properties are values sent with events. Visitors, visits, and events are counted separately; the missing row reveals events that did not send this property.
dashboard.behavior.properties.empty_hint: Enable a property your tracker has already sent to analyze its values here.
dashboard.infodot.label: Why this number looks wrong
dashboard.map.too_small_help_one: One more country had traffic but is too small to draw at this scale — the Countries tab lists every one.
dashboard.map.too_small_help_other: {count} more countries had traffic but are too small to draw at this scale — the Countries tab lists every one.
dashboard.no_sites.body: Add a site and install the tracking snippet, and its traffic will appear here within a few seconds.
dashboard.no_sites.title: No sites yet
dashboard.locked.title: Your dashboard is locked
dashboard.realtime.caveat.engagement: Background engagement pings do not count. They fire when a tab loses focus, with no navigation behind them, so counting one would report an abandoned tab as a reader.
dashboard.realtime.caveat.window: Somebody counts as current if they did something in the last five minutes — a page, a click, a custom event.
dashboard.realtime.graph_note: read from raw events, refreshed every 30 seconds
dashboard.report.devices.caveat: Type is read from the browser's own description of itself, and Screen from the size of the window. They are two different facts and they disagree often: a phone-sized window on a desktop is a desktop with a narrow window, not a phone. Rows reading “(not set)” across every tab at once are one cause — a browser that sent no usable description — rather than four separate faults.
dashboard.report.devices.title: Devices
dashboard.report.languages.caveat: The language a visitor's browser asks for, which is the language they configured rather than the one they can read. Someone reading English on a Spanish-language laptop counts as Spanish here.
dashboard.report.languages.title: Languages
dashboard.report.locations.caveat: Location comes from the visitor's IP address, which is looked up and then discarded — we never write it down. A VPN, a corporate network or a mobile carrier will place someone where their provider is rather than where they are.
dashboard.report.locations.cities_caveat: City is approximate, and structurally so. Mobile carriers and large employers route whole regions through a handful of exchanges, so a visitor in one town resolves to their provider's hub in another. Read this tab as a shape, not as a list of addresses.
dashboard.report.locations.title: Locations
dashboard.report.pages.caveat: Unique visitors can come out higher than pageviews on a site that fires custom events. A visitor who only triggers events and never loads a tracked page is counted once as a visitor and never as a view.
dashboard.report.pages.title: Top Pages
dashboard.report.sources.caveat: The visitors in these rows can add up to more than your total unique visitors. The same person can arrive from a search engine in the morning and type your address in the afternoon — one unique visitor, two source rows. Switch the column to Visits in the details view for a figure that does add up.
dashboard.report.sources.title: Top Sources
dashboard.shortcuts.annotations: Jump to the first note on the graph
dashboard.sampled.automatic: Estimated from {percent}% deterministic buckets at each metric's event or session row grain. Before applying that rate, the raw plan represented about {rows} fact-row reads. Additive totals are expanded; rates, averages, minima, maxima, and percentiles are calculated directly in sampled rows and may differ materially when values are skewed. No confidence interval is claimed.
dashboard.sampled.exact_required: This report needs complete visitor or visit membership and cannot be estimated safely.
dashboard.sampled.exact_note: Showing exact numbers. A wide range takes longer to answer.
dashboard.sampled.requested: Estimated from the requested {percent}% deterministic buckets at each metric's event or session row grain. Additive totals are expanded; rates, averages, minima, maxima, and percentiles are calculated directly in sampled rows and may differ materially when values are skewed. No confidence interval is claimed.
dashboard.sampled.sparse: At least one metric grain has fewer than 100 expected sampled fact-row reads.
dashboard.sampled.zero: Every returned sampled metric is zero; this does not prove the full population is zero.
dashboard.shortcuts.compare: Turn the comparison on or off
dashboard.shortcuts.escape: Close what is open, or clear every filter
dashboard.shortcuts.footnote: Shortcuts are off while you are typing in a field, and a key held with ⌘, Ctrl or Alt belongs to the browser rather than to us.
dashboard.shortcuts.search: Jump to the nearest search box
dashboard.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
dashboard.topbar.current_visitors.help: Visitors seen in the last 30 minutes — the window a visit stays open for
